svg.title: What the Olympic bid promises officials
svg.desc: An international stage: Athletes would appear before spectators unfamiliar with cricket.. A commercial hope: Leaders hope to reach customers in the United States.. The writer’s question: Why should greater market reach be a sufficient reason?

g.text: What the Olympic bid promises officials
Athletes would appear before spectators unfamiliar with cricket.
Leaders hope to reach customers in the United States.
Why should greater market reach be a sufficient reason?
